```{r}
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
rna<-read.csv('./Data/Muscle_transciptome.csv')

rna_met<-read.csv("./Data/human-precovid-sed-adu_t06-muscle_transcript-rna-seq_metadata_features_v2.0.csv")
```
  
```{r}
head(rna)

rna_24 <- rna |>
  filter(contrast == "group_timepointADUEndur.post_24_hr - group_timepointADUEndur.pre_exercise - group_timepointADUControl.post_24_hr + group_timepointADUControl.pre_exercise")   

rna_24_ranked <- rna_24 |>
  arrange(desc(logFC))

rna_24_ranked_gene <- left_join(
  rna_24_ranked,
  rna_met |> select(feature_id, gene_symbol),
  by = "feature_id"
)

rna_24_ranked_gene <- rna_24_ranked_gene |>
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol))
  

write.csv(rna_24_ranked_gene, "ranked_24_control.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)

volcano_data <- rna_24_ranked_gene |>
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      adj_p_value < 0.05 & logFC > 0.5 ~ "Upregulated",
      adj_p_value < 0.05 & logFC < -0.5 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(adj_p_value)
  )

# Select genes to label
label_genes <- volcano_data |>
  filter(
    adj_p_value < 0.00017,
    abs(logFC) > 0.5,
    !is.na(gene_symbol)
  )

# Volcano plot
ggplot(volcano_data,
       aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_padj,
           color = significance)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_genes,
    aes(label = gene_symbol),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.4
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Upregulated" = "red",
    "Downregulated" = "blue",
    "Not significant" = "grey75"
  )) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +

  theme_classic() +

  labs(
    title = "24h Post-Endurance Exercise Upregulated vs Down rgulated ",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
    color = "Expression"
  )
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Top upregulated genes
up_genes <- volcano_data |>
  filter(adj_p_value < 0.05, logFC > 0.5) |>
  arrange(desc(logFC))

# Top downregulated genes
down_genes <- volcano_data |>
  filter(adj_p_value < 0.05, logFC < -0.5) |>
  arrange(logFC)

# Combine into one dataframe
top_16_genes <- bind_rows(up_genes, down_genes) |>
  select(gene_symbol, logFC, p_value, adj_p_value, significance)

# View dataframe
View(top_16_genes)

# Export
write.csv(top_16_genes, "top_exercise_genes.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
